title: RES-D4 HD-2 Peer-Roster Substrate Stub (Tag-71)
description: Audit-only fixture catalogue for the HD-2 Peer-Roster substrate-preparation work. This file enumerates the peer-roster snapshot shape, the strict-interpretation invariant for production-active peer counting, the verifier-acceptance branches, and the cross-team handoff anchors that the Tag-71 substrate-prep work is allowed to inspect, document, and frame-test in fixture mode. It MUST NOT be interpreted as a federation peer-count claim: every enumerated peer carries 'kind: fixture' and every production-count branch is gated by the strict-interpretation invariant. See docs/operations/res-d4-high-residual-mitigation-deep-dive.md §3.2 / §6.3 / §7 / §8.

upstream_anchors.tag_67_pre_mortem_anchor: §5.1 A2+B2+B3 (peer-rotation TOCTOU + loose-count + CFO ratification envelope)
upstream_anchors.tag_69_deep_dive_anchor: §3.2 HD-2 mitigation strategy, §7 peer-roster substrate-prep, §7.1 strict-interpretation invariant

strict_interpretation_invariant.identified: listed in production-active roster with kind: production

fixture_peers.purpose: Validate the roster-snapshot shape with a fixture-peer entry. Verifier filters peer-count by 'kind == production', so this entry MUST NOT count toward the HD-2 minimum-two threshold.

Validate the roster-snapshot shape with a second fixture-peer entry. Pair (peer-A, peer-B) exercises the count-of-two literal trigger under strict-interpretation: count == 0 for production, even though count == 2 for fixture.

Negative-control roster entry: a verifier asked to apply loose-interpretation (counting fixtures as production) MUST reject with a 'strict-interpretation' diagnostic. This frame exists to pin the B2 failure-mode mitigation in tests.

fixture_frames.name: roster-snapshot-frame--pending-production-growth
fixture_frames.purpose: Validate the producer-side roster-snapshot frame shape when the federation has fixture peers but zero production peers. The verifier must accept this frame in audit-only mode and reject it in promotion-eligible mode.

fixture_frames.name: roster-snapshot-frame--single-production-insufficient
fixture_frames.purpose: Validate the producer-side roster-snapshot frame shape with one production peer and one fixture peer. The strict-interpretation invariant means production-count == 1 < 2, so HD-2 is NOT satisfied. The verifier accepts the frame in audit-only mode but the HD-2 condition remains pending.

fixture_frames.name: roster-snapshot-frame--loose-count-forbidden
fixture_frames.purpose: Negative-control frame: a frame claiming production-count = 2 by counting fixtures. The verifier must reject this frame with a clear 'strict-interpretation' diagnostic per §7.1.

verifier_acceptance_rules.rule: audit-only branch accepts roster-snapshots with kind-discriminated peer entries
loose-interpretation roster-snapshots are rejected with 'strict-interpretation' diagnostic
roster-snapshot is read at issuance, not at verification (TOCTOU mitigation)
